description: This file defines a set of functions for generating indented JSON output within a CMake build script. It includes callback functions for constructing JSON objects and arrays with proper indentation, as well as handling JSON literals and key-value pairs. The functions use a map data structure for maintaining context and indentation level during JSON construction.

methods.name: json_indented
methods.description: Main function to generate indented JSON using callback functions and context mapping.

methods.name: json_obj_begin_indented
methods.description: Starts a JSON object with indentation.

methods.name: json_obj_end_indented
methods.description: Ends a JSON object, appending closing brace with indentation.

methods.name: json_array_begin_indented
methods.description: Starts a JSON array with indentation.

methods.name: json_array_end_indented
methods.description: Ends a JSON array, appending closing bracket with indentation.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin_indented
methods.description: Begins a key-value pair in a JSON object with indentation.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end_indented
methods.description: Ends a key-value pair, adding comma if needed, with indentation.

methods.name: json_array_element_begin_indented
methods.description: Begins an array element with proper indentation.

methods.name: json_array_element_end_indented
methods.description: Ends an array element, adding comma if needed, with indentation.

methods.name: json_literal_indented
methods.description: Outputs a JSON literal value with proper formatting and escaping.
